working_directory.description: Working directory for new terminal instances

command.description: Command to execute in the terminal (e.g., '/bin/bash')

font.description: Font name and size, in Pango format

cell_spacing.description: Spacing between terminal cells in pixels

transparent_background.description: Enable transparent background (if supported by compositor)

show_header_bar.description: Show or hide the header bar with tabs and controls

theme_from_scheme.description: Use the terminal color scheme to theme the application

shortcuts.description:
List of custom keyboard shortcuts as key-value pairs (e.g., 'copy = <Ctrl><Shift>C')
Each item is a map with 'key' and 'val' fields describing the shortcut binding and its action.
